historical_r09_failure_audit.numeric_gate: The failure was a real independent operation/reference error, not model-quality comparison. Fidelity Case[6] picks BF16 compressor projections despite its artifact name. Projection.reference rounds activation to BF16 and uses values decoded from the actual written BF16 weights. Close their obligation as excluded preview scope; do not mark them repaired, rename them quality loss, or claim the new GA BF16/QAT ratio4 result reran the old all-F32 recipe. ordinary_rope_boundary.public_contract: RoPE declares rotary dimensions, sequence axis and layout; user docs require explicit Cast nodes to express F32 rotation. No F64 trig implementation, all-position absolute/relative accuracy bound or whole-compressor4e-5 gate is promised.

ordinary_rope_boundary.finding: No current same-operation/same-geometry isolated counterexample against a published accuracy requirement was found in the reviewed evidence.
